how_to_use: Put it in series to limit current (e.g. before an LED), or use it as a pull-up / pull-down or in a voltage divider. It works either way round.

plain.what: A 2.2 kΩ resistor — it limits how much electricity flows. For small signals.
plain.how: It works either way round. The coloured stripes tell you its value. Put it in line with the part it protects, like an LED.
